notes: All Plymouth factory brochures count as one source. Hagerty Media and Hagerty Valuation Tools count together as one source (Hagerty).
Motorious/Yahoo 'Motorious Explores the Plymouth Barracuda' copies Wikipedia wording ('approximately fifty', '2.8-liter with 101 bhp'), so it is not counted.

Some web pages (musclecarfacts, over-drive-magazine, oldride) claim a 1969 440 Six Pack (390 hp) and ~50 1969 Hemi Barracudas. Both are wrong: the 440 Six Barrel and street Hemi came with the 1970 E-body, and the Hemi cars were the 1968 BO29 race cars. Not counted.
1966 brochure option footnote mentions a '170-cu.-in. engine' (shared Valiant copy), but the 1966 spec page lists only the 225 six; NHRA 1966 has no 170.
